description.value: The Kanaka Creek Watershed Stewardship Centre, also known as the Bell-Irving Fish Hatchery, is an environmental education facility within Kanaka Creek Regional Park in Metro Vancouver's regional park system. Operated by the Kanaka Education and Environmental Partnership Society, it focuses on watershed stewardship and salmon habitat along Kanaka Creek. Touring cyclists exploring the Fraser Valley's regional trail network may find it a worthwhile nature stop en route through Maple Ridge.
